caseName: United States ex rel. Shing v. Shaughnessy
caseNameFull: United States ex rel. Lee Wo Shing v. Shaughnessy, Acting District Director of the Immigration and Naturalization Service
attorneys: Abraham Lebenkoff and Harry J. Stein for petitioner., Solicitor General Perlman filed a memorandum for respondent.

opinions.text:
On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit.

Per Curiam:

The petition for writ of certiorari is granted and the judgment is reversed. Wong Yang Sung v. McGrath, ante, p. 33.

Mr. Justice Clark took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
